turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're having game night on Friday, and I need to pick what to buy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Don't weigh in yet, Moshi, there's more than one and I want to cover them all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is a big strategy game about building cities, about two hours to play.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a quick party game with drawing and guessing that works for up to ten people.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a cooperative game where everyone works together to stop a spreading disease.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a word game with cards that's short and pretty easy to learn.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, yeah, I think that's it. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How many people are coming, and are they into games? For a big casual crowd, the party game wins. For four keen players, I'd go with the city building one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, and another thing. I found a box of my old game cartridges in my mum's loft. Are they worth anything?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some can be! It depends on the console, which games, and their condition. Do you still have the boxes and manuals?
